notes.title: Update 1.11.8.29 is out now!
notes.notes:
[b]New Features[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Super Weapon Shop[/b] - The shop found on the Church now only sells Weapons, but all at level 10! These are quite expensive, so you’ll need to save up your Iron if you want to be able to afford them.
[*] [b]Random Weapon Shops[/b] - These shops offer weapons for a lower price, but the weapon is only revealed once you buy it.
[*] [b]Random Item Shops (1 of each type)[/b] - These shops are similar to the Random Weapon shops, but instead of only weapons they offer 1 random item of each type: a Weapon, an Ability, and a Charm.
[*] [b]Paid health at the Haven[/b] - There are 3 additional Health Items in the Haven now, but these must be bought with Iron. The Refill barrel in the Haven no longer heals the Hero, but it does still refill his Health Flask. 
[*] [b]Resurrection Item (reclaimed embers)[/b] - A new item can now be found in the Havens before the Church and the Final Boss. These ‘Reclaimed Embers’ can save the Hero at the point of death, giving him a second chance without having to start back at the Crypt.
[*] [b]One-Hit Protection[/b] - If the Hero remaining HP is over 20% of his maximum and at least 30HP, if he receives damage that would kill him he will instead be reduced to 1hp. This effect can only occur once every 30 seconds.	
[*] [b]Wave Rooms[/b] - New Challenge Rooms! Some of the locking rooms found throughout Purgatory will now start empty and spawn waves of enemies. The doors will only open once all waves have been defeated.	
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*] Revolver reload speed increased.
[*] The Mortar now has a larger damage radius but slightly longer reload time.
[*] Greater Sin/Iron rewards for Outlaws, Lost Souls and Bosses.	
[*] Sin rewarded for destroying Injustices’ Ritual Pillars.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] No more duplicate items at the Witch.	
[*] Armoury no longer shows grenade items that haven’t been unlocked.
[*] The Legions found in the Canyon and Churchyard should now display a pre-attack ground warning, like the Legion found in the Mines does.
[*] Reload time on weapon descriptions now shows a previously hidden reload delay.
[*] Weapon descriptions now show stun damage as well as regular damage.
[*] The Lantern ability now shows its Stun status effect duration. 
[*] Teleporting no longer works on exploding barrels, caged lanterns or hanging boxes.
[*] Refilling health flask UI prompt says "Replenish health" and not "Replenish flask"
[*] Mortar - Fixed an bug where it was not hitting multiple targets, not scaling damage correctly
[*] Reload Delay now shown on the Weapon Details
[*] Fixed an issue with Health Flask and interacting with Outlaw
[*] Fixed an instance where player was unable to hit the exploding barrels with a spear/axe
[*] No longer possible to use lasso on exploding barrels
[*] Fixed an issue with enemy animation still playing "stunned" animation even though enemy is not stunned anymore
[*] Mortar shot accuracy changes based on aiming - if you just pull the trigger without holding first the shots will be very inaccurate.
[*] Mortar now damages environment objects (like cover, barricades and exploding barrels).
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11.7.11 is out now!
notes.notes:
[b]Gameplay Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Added Beacons to the Start and End of each level in Chapter 4. These can be examined to help you locate Righteous Souls.
[*] If you miss a Righteous Soul no more will appear in the current run.
[*] Curses from Lost Souls and Righteous Souls now stack.
[*] The Molotov ability used by the Preacher and Outlaws now has a delay on the explosion.
[*] The Creeping Gold trap in the mine now causes the burn status effect instead of damage. The effect is applied after 0.5 seconds (giving you a moment to get out of it).
[*] Injustice is now guaranteed to drop the Hellraiser remnant
[*] Remnant drop rate increased for rarer/tougher enemies
[*] Massive reduction in the Sin cost of the more expensive unlocks.
[/list]
[b]Weapon and Ability Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Mine Ability - duration increased again, cooldown increased, additional mine dropped, trigger range slightly increased, distance thrown slightly increased
[*] Mine Damage now scales with Resourcefulness level.
[*] Trap duration increased
[*] Workhorse - slight damage nerf
[*] Escalator - damage increased
[*] Splitter now splits into 3 fragments, increased from 2
[*] Flaregun reload time significantly reduced.
[*] Flaregun flares now last longer, will stick to enemies as well as walls, and their light allows 
[*] Range of melee knife abilities increased
[*] Throwing knife damage increased
[*] Trickshot ricochet damage increased.
[*] The Splitter and Trickshot no longer lock-on, making it easier to ricochet shots.
[*] Shield cooldown increased
[/list]
[b]GUI Changes[/b] 
[list]
[*] The Health Bar will now flash when at less than 20%, or less than 30hp.
[*] Weapons now show ricochet damage in their descriptions (Splitter and Trickshot weapons) enemies to be locked on to.
[*] Status Effect damage now scales correctly with item level.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Level Exit Narration should now be correct
[*] Fixed two instances where the locking doors would not open after killing all the enemies.
[*] Boss homing magic no longer passes through pillars
[*] Heavy Cultist magic no longer passes through pillars
[*] Fixed a bug where Mines were getting stuck on enemies.
[*] Fixed a bug where the Witch Unlock Menu wouldn't open.
[*] Fixed an issue where players could be hit while vaulting over cover, causing them to get stuck. This was mainly an issue during the Injustice boss battle.
[*] Fixed an issue where The Hunt level would sometimes not generate correctly on a continued run, causing the player to fall through the floor.
[*] Splitter ricochet damage now scales with aim duration (previously it would always be max damage)
[*] Fixed the damage area of the shockwave attack used by some bosses.
[*] The Injustice Boss will no longer get stuck on cover.
[*] Mortar - now damages neutral targets (such as cover, barricades and exploding barrels)
[*] Iron Costs - all weapons can now be afforded on the Crypt
[*] Slomo effect will no longer play during the intro of a boss battle.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.11.6.2 is out now!
notes.notes:
Howdy, gunslingers. There’s a new patch in town.

In our continuous efforts to improve West of Dead we’re happy to present [b]Update 1.11.6.2[/b]. Featuring a variety of tweaks, improvements and squashed bugs.

In case you missed it:
Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1016790/view/3031454320657536220]Bone Orchard Update[/url], which among other things introduced this [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1016790/view/3034833287937353748]strange fella[/url].

Also, please don’t hesitate to leave us a review on the store page to let us know what you think of the game! 

Adios. *tips hats and stoically rides off into the sunset*

[h2]Update 1.11.6.2 Changelog
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where “fog of war” on the minimap would return to already visited areas if the player resumed a run. 
[*] The Bloat (The exploding creature) now gives more warning when aggro'd, so hopefully will be avoidable at the bottom of ladders.
[/list]

The Window Snipers (Turret Traps) in the Town have had some work done:
[list]
[*] A light has been added to make them more obvious.
[*] They can now be locked on to.
[*] They now deactivate for 10-15 seconds after being shot (used to be 5-10 seconds).
[*] To make them more obvious, they now open their window shutters when active and close them when inactive.
[/list]

Exploding barrels have been tweaked
[list]
[*] Slight damage increase.
[*] Barrels now fall to the floor after being shot, a red warning circle is shown before they explode.
[/list]

notes.title: The Bone Orchard Update, Now Live!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36756648/5c07c1214396b88c80c2c8650a03ea9d22c11e26.png[/img]

Gunslingers, get ready for a hog-killin' time! This is our biggest update so far - A bag filled to the brim with new features, balancing updates and bug fixes. Without further ado, let me introduce;

[h3]The Bone Orchard Update [/h3] 

[b]Gameplay Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Locking rooms added - all enemies must be killed to exit.
[*] Dynamite Barrels - added to the Crypt, Hunt, Mine, Canyon, Battlefield, Town and Church
[*] Plague Barrels - added to the Bayou, Plains, Churchyard and Church
[*] Freeze Barrels - added to the Hunt, Mine, Battlefield, Churchyard and Church
[*] Heal Barrels - added to the Bayou, Canyon, Plains, Town and Church
[*] New Shrines - Limited choice shrines added to branches
[*] New Shrine appearance - the shrines show skulls for each available choice
[/list]
[b]Balance - Difficulty[/b]
[list]
[*] Overall difficulty reduced
[*] Enemy health and damage rebalanced
[*] Enemy composition rebalanced
[*] Final Boss rebalanced
[*] 4 different Difficulty Settings added
[*] Status Effects now increase in damage with level - this used to be duration
[*] Gravedigger attack reworked
[*] Damage over time effects base damage rebalanced
[*] Preacher and Outlaw difficulty rebalanced
[*] Level Layouts refined
[*] Fewer pickups per level
[*] Lost Soul Burden is now 3x damage instead of Instant Death
[*] Weapon/Ability Unlock order changed
[*] Unlock Sin Costs significantly reduced
[*] Amount of Iron found in levels has been reduced
[*] Remnant drop rate increased. This is even higher in more difficult levels.
[*] Wendigo Boss moved to the mid-point of The Hunt - you can no longer avoid him!
[/list]
[b]Balance - Weapons[/b]
[list]
[*] Sniper Rifle - Longer aim time, higher damage.
[*] Escalator Rifle - Less initial damage, much greater subsequent damage.
[*] Wrack & Ruin Revolver - Accuracy tweaks. 
[*] Clockwork Shotgun - Higher rate of fire, slower reload.
[*] Eradicator - much higher damage, longer charge time, can shoot through multiple targets.
[*] Hellraiser - accuracy tweaks.
[*] Double Barreled Pistol - Lower base damage.
[*] Freeze Pistol - Lower base damage.
[*] Maverick Pistol - Lower base damage, higher critical damage.
[*] Deadshot Revolver - Higher critical damage.
[*] Traitor’s Revolver - Higher critical damage.
[*] Defender Shotgun - Lower damage.
[*] Killspree Shotgun - Lower damage.
[*] Stalker Shotgun - Speed buff duration increased.
[*] Gunslinger Revolver - Rate of Fire buff after dodging has been increased.
[/list]
[b]GUI Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Weapon and Ability GUI panels now shows more details:
[*] DoT effects
[*] Critical Damage 
[*] Escalator Shot Damage
[*] Ammo display corrected for Hellraiser and Wrack & Ruin
[*] Ability Cooldowns now rounded to 1 decimal place.
[*] Charms added to the pause menu.
[*] Charm GUI panels now shows more details:
[*] Buff multipliers
[*] Buff durations
[*] HP recovery per action
[*] Maximum possible HP recovery
[/list]
[b]Teleporters / Runes:[/b]
[list]
[*] All Rune Obstacles now prompt you if you don’t have the required Rune.
[*] End of Level teleporters now tell you which level they lead to.
[*] Teleporters now only ignite if you have the teleport Rune.
[*] Shortcut teleporters activate but are a different colour and tell you that they require a Rune.
[/list]
[b]Onboarding and Game flow:[/b]
[list]
[*] New Tutorial layout
[*] Tutorial Prompts changed 
[*] Chasm warnings added 
[*] Movement prompt removed
[*] Saving disabled in the Tutorial
[*] Death now starts a New Run, rather than taking you to the Start Menu
[*] Saving/Quitting has been re-enabled in the Saloon
[*] Hint & Tips Fortune Cards added to the Saloon
[*] GUI text to tell the player when Purgatory is Shifting (level layouts changing)
[*] New Rune Unlock objects in the Armoury - examining these gives a description of their use and where their shortcut is.
[/list]
[b]Cosmetic Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changes to the Start Screen theme - floating purgatory objects in the distance
[*] Sawn-off shotgun now fired one-handed
[*] Locking doors are now more visible
[*] Start Menu Options now split between system Options and Game Options 
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Barman’s charm now works correctly.
[*] Seer’s charm now works correctly.
[*] Prospectors charm now works correctly.
[*] Thrown abilities (molotov, dynamite etc.) should no longer bounce off horizontal surfaces (like the cover in the Preacher fight).
[*] Lost Soul / Righteous Soul bugs fixed
[*] Unlock menu typo fixed
[*] Weapon tutorial info panel bug fixed
[*] Plague damage scales with item/weapon level and character stats when spread.
[*] The Preacher no longer shoots through cover (issue with the Splitter rifle fixed)
[*] Targeting bugs fixed
[*] Issues with the locking door in the Haven have been fixed
[*] The Butcher no longer misses with his ranged attack
[*] Issue with Indestructible Rune Barricades has been fixed
[*] An issue causing The Hunt level to not generate has been fixed.
[*] The pause menu map should now track properly
[*] Outlaw/Preacher AI bug fixes
[*] Heal effects fixed for enemies
[/list]

notes.title: Wayfarin Update, Available Now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36756648/8ceef460c38fa56121923c9da87092234db2da62.png[/img]
Hey Outaws! 

Here comes another big one, we've been listening, watching and counting (through the magic of analytics) as you've all played, and have made a patch that focuses on Balance, Tuning and a few 'High Demand' features.

[b]v. 0.10.0 - Patch 3 - Wayfarin,[/b]
 
[b]Balance Improvements[/b]
We've looked at the entire balance of West of Dead, from top to bottom, and have implemented a lot of changes to smooth out difficulty spikes and generally allow a more steady sense of progression.
 
[b]Overall Balance:[/b]
• Enemy health scaling with level difficulty has been reduced, to make them feel less 'tanky' later on.
• "Hard-Path" Levels (The Bayou, Canyon, Graveyard, War) have their enemy difficulty slightly reduced, but still higher than the "Easy-Path"
 
[b]Level Redesigns:[/b]
• New Level Layouts - Some more maze-like, others more uniform, from now on, players will (in some levels) be able to better find the exit, or choose to explore more.
• Levels now have extra loot, hidden behind unlockable obstacles.
• Rooms have more cover, and fewer columns generally. Making late-game gunfight more in your favour.
 
[b]Enemy Balance:[/b]
We've looked into lots of specific enemy behaviour, and have tweaked and improved them so that enemies are dangerous as a team, not because of particularly obnoxious 'star players'.
• Endless Rifleman: Reduced their health and attack frequency. (Making these an introduction to the mechanics, not deadly assassins in level 1)
• Keelut (Dogs): Reduced health and damage, as well as fewer of them in the Farm. (We want these to feel like nuisance fodder enemies, not hounds bent on your destruction)
• Endless Shotgun: Movement speed increased, Damage vs cover increased, Range increased. (These were under-performing, so we gave them a slight edge)
• Camazotz (Flying Melee): Base health reduced, Correct balancing set (Were under-powered, so balanced their stats)
• Broken Shotgunner: Melee replaced with Point-Blank Shotgun (nasty), Rarer
• Broken Stalker: Rarer
• Broken Grenadier: Rarer
• Legion (Mines): Rarer
• Legion (Graveyard): Now attacks twice consecutively.
• Bloat (exploding enemy): More fragile, Rarer
• Dakwa (Cover-Smasher): Rarer
• Cultist (Flank and Teleport): Rarer
• Preacher Bosses (and Stand-Ins): Health increased, Immune to light, Drop more sin. (These boss encounters seemed to be breezed through, so we've toughened them up, but they also give more reward)
• Rune Bosses: Health increased (except for Wendigo)
• Outlaw: Immune to light
• Preacher-replacements - health/loadout now matches the Preacher's
 
[b]Specific Level work:[/b]
• The War (DLC): Artillery Bombardment added
 
[b]Targeting, Pass III:[/b]
We've done a couple of things to complete the Targeting re-design roll out:
• New Targeting applied to Abilities Abilities now target enemies in a way that is more consistent with firearms, whether you are throwing an axe, spear or teleporting, you should be able to choose your target with more confidence.
• Targeting Assist Settings. This was a hotly requested feature, and depending on whether you want to play as a twin-stick 'purist' or have the game do more of the aiming for you to let you concentrate on tactics, we have a setting for you, even 'off'.
 
[b]Quality of Life:[/b]
• Remnants are dropped from specific enemies (previously they were random) - this will let you hunt down those missing, exciting weapons.
• Throwing axes hit more often (bigger hitbox)
• Level name is displayed in the map
• Objects appear in the map from further away
• Narrator only says the Barman has something to say when the Barman has something *important* to say
• Options menu slight redesign to prevent text overlap
• Fonts working with Polish
 
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
• Level Generation has better joining corridors in levels that ascend or descend
• Mismatching Shaman ("Witch Woman") line is removed
• Animation fix from trapped into crouch
• Enemy traps animate again
• Hero no longer knocked back when trapped
• 'Swarm' enemy no longer causes stun damage

notes.title: v. 0.9.23 Patch - More Quick and More Dead
notes.notes:
Thanks to our community of players, we've been able to pull the 'More Quick and More Dead' patch together, which addresses some high demand features and improvements such as key bindings for PC, cover movement and Charms balancing!

[list]
[*] We hope you enjoy it, and continue to enjoy West of Dead. Thanks for your feedback!
[*] Quality of life improvements
[*] We've focused on making the game more accessible, smoother and easier to control and to smooth off 'snags' that interrupt game flow:
[*] PC Only Customisable Controls! We've added Customisable controls for Keyboard and Mouse.
[*]Sticky Cover - We've looked at the difficulty that some people have had getting around corners of cover. This is now easier, and the cover is also generally a little more 'sticky'. If that sounds like it's going to be harder to exit cover in a hurry - we have replaced the dive out of cover with a new *slide* which can instantly be chained into a further dive.
[*] Balance - Increased Shotgun ranges by ~2m, so that they remain useful in early and late run
[*] Heavy enemies are rebalanced (generally slightly nerfed), these were causing some real spikes in difficulty (and deaths) so we've mixed them in more nicely.
[*] Unlocking GUI list is faster, and sorted. This should make unlocking quicker and simpler.
[*] Lost souls look even more sad than before - we've given them a new animation, hope you like it.
[*] Shopkeeper no longer takes control of the camera when you leave!
[*] Snappier aim animations when shooting from cover. Sometimes, people would find shooting from cover was 'snagged' with the gun firing before it was aimed properly, now fixed.
[*] If you have completed chapter 4, it no longer displays that at the start screen.
[*] Boss doors open earlier after fights, letting you crack on with the rest of your run.
[*] Status effects are not applied if the character is invulnerable, this should make the game feel more fair.
[*] If the hero becomes trapped, they won't receive 2x damage. This will still happen to enemies, so use those traps when you unlock them!
[*] Swarm enemies no longer insta stun the hero, they will still slow him though.
[*]New hero *Trapped* animation, so you know what is going on more clearly.
[*] Dropped Mines do more damage based on your resourcefulness level.
[*] Slightly sped up text animation.
[/list]

[b]Charms[/b]

[list]
[*] Charms are now revisited to make sure that they are more evenly balanced and generally more useful. Every charm should be exciting to find and use:
[*] Aggressor's Charm: Buff - Recover health back in 2 hits, not 5.
[*] Defender's Charm: Slight Nerf - Recover health in 2 seconds, not 1.
[*] Jester's Charm: Buff: Stronger reload strength and duration
[*] Prospector's Charm and Seer's Charm: Buffed - significantly increased find rate
[*] Gunslinger's Charm: Buff - higher general reload adjustment
[*] Barman's Charm: Buff - 50% Additional health recovery from item consumption
[*] Visuals and Performance
[*] By revisiting our rendering tech, and our in game assets, we've streamlined the title, making it both prettier, and smoother!
[*] New Post Effect pipeline, faster, and with a smoother finish!
[*] Optimised art assets, meaning smaller package, lower memory overhead and better performance!
[*] Disabled additional effects when culling such as torches for a performance boost
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Hero can no longer punch or kick enemies through walls
[*] Camera is more stable
[*] Panel elements no longer overlap button prompts on pickups
[*] If you had previously missed out on the trophies associated with defeating the preacher or injustice - these will now be retroactively awarded. (#1519)
[*] Creeping gold doesn't trap you in place on hurting you - thanks for your feedback!

notes.title: Sure Shot Patch
notes.notes:
[u][b]v0.9.19.1 The Sure Shot update[/b][/u]

[b]Quality of Life:[/b]

Aiming with firearms and darkness! We have completely re-thought the aiming algorithm with the goal of allowing you to 'aim' into the dark when you want to. From now on, you will shoot at the target you are most aiming at, whether it is lit or in darkness. The difference between the two is that lit enemies have auto lock applied (highlight and aim assist), whereas enemies in the dark will have no auto lock applied whatsoever. The main difference is that lit enemies will no longer 'gobble up' your aim if you intend to shoot at a target in the shadows. Note, we have kept the ability aiming algorithm the same, so that we can get this change in early, rather than wait for that.

This change was heavily inspired by your insightful feedback. Thank you! Fixes:
Injustice can now be truly banished! The pillars in the injustice arena are now vulnerable when you have done the thing you need to do to unlock them (spoiler averted).

Fixed the Boss Unkillable fix, which was caused when applying freeze during the fight!
Fixed the Outlaw Soft lock issue, where sometimes the outlaw will not light the lantern in it's room.
Defeating the preacher II should unlock the Met your Match award.

[b]Small fixes:[/b]
Characters face one another when chatting - isn't that nice?
Righteous souls fade out a little more smoothly.
Enemies no longer slide when dying.
Outlaw room doesn't lock you out.
Aggressor charm description.
Some Chinese localisation fixes.

Note:
We have changed the save version to support these changes. This will mean that your current run will be lost, however your progress in that run (any sin spent etc.) will not be.

notes.title: Patch Notes for v0.9.18
notes.notes:
v0.9.18" 
 
Major changes:
- The player will no longer aim at enemies through walls
- The player will no longer aim through the barricade when closed
- Favours no longer have levels - these served no clear purpose
- Adjusted sin cost of items. These were too expensive and meant that you had to do *lots* of runs before you could unlock many of the items. The amount of sin you can get at later levels has been reduced slightly, meaning that unsuccessful runs count more than before (in proportion).
 
Minor tweaks:
- Cover regen feels less nasty if it pushes you back.
- Happens more suddenly - less time thinking you should use it when you cant.
- Fewer rib cages lying around :wink:
 
We hope you enjoy this first Quality of Life patch, more is to come!
A big thanks to all our players for the incredible feedback and issue reporting.v0.9.18"

notes.title: Player Support Guide
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36756648/8ceef460c38fa56121923c9da87092234db2da62.png[/img]

Players can always contact the awesome Raw Fury Quality field for support by using this form: [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]Player Support Form[/url]

Please go through these steps first as this guide is intended to be used before contacting the helpdesk. 
Removing game save data

[b]If a player perhaps just wants to restart on a clean slate or is experiencing a game-breaking issue it will help to remove all the game save data.[/b]

PC:

[b]IMPORTANT:
[/b]
Remember to turn off steam cloud saves before doing this! Otherwise Steam will just get the data again. This can be turned off in the game properties under the Update tab.

Hold down the Windows key and press R
Type in %appdata% and hit enter
This should open up the roaming folder. Hit back once so you end up in the AppData folder.
Enter the folder named locallow
Locate and delete the folder named Upstream arcade
Restart the game

XB1:

Make sure the game is off
Click on the Xbox button on your controller to bring up the sidebar menu
Navigate to West of Dead and click the “OPTIONS/START” button to open the menu
Select game save data & add-ons
Go down to save game data
On the right, navigate to your Gamertag
Select your Gamertag and when prompted, select the option “Remove everywhere”

[b]If the game isn’t starting or is crashing upon startup the player should update the graphics drivers:[/b]


Nvidia:
Go to Nvidia site and locate your graphics card and download your latest drivers.
Alternatively use their Nvidia experience software to update them.

AMD:
https://www.amd.com/en/support
Make sure you have no other software running in the background. Such as remote desktop and weird anti-virus software (however never turn off the Microsoft Defender!!) As these can cause the game to not function properly or crash.

If no error can be found please then attach the game logs and send it to the Raw Fury helpdesk
 
[b]Retrieving log files & save data:[/b]

Hold down the Windows key and press R
Type in %appdata% and hit enter
This should open the roaming folder, go back one time and then head to the locallow folder
Locate the folder named "upstream arcade" zip it down and send it to Raw Fury support helpdesk [url=https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1]https://rawfury.atlassian.net/servicedesk/customer/portal/1[/url]


[b]My controller isn't working:[/b]

Several things could be wrong here. But first of all, which controller are you using. The officially supported controllers are Xbox One gamepad and PS4 Dualshock.

Steam could be causing some issues. You can try unchecking any boxes in the “General controller settings” under the controller tab in Steam settings. OR if that does not do the trick you can try setting up the controller again via Steam controller settings.

notes.title: The West of Dead Beta Starts Today at 16:00 CEST - Here's What's New!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36756648/8ceef460c38fa56121923c9da87092234db2da62.png[/img]

Hey everyone. 

The beta will run from today (30 April), starting at 16:00 CEST (07:00 PST) until the 7th May (23:59 PST and 08:59 on the 8th May CEST). If you enjoy the beta, we would really appreciate you adding West of Dead to your wishlist. 

This time around we are showcasing the first 2 levels, and while, if this is not your first trip to Purgatory, you may have played them before, the levels are a bit different from what you remember. 

We have taken the time to take on your feedback and these levels have had a lot of fixes and polish added to them. See the end of this post for the list of fixes  

Right now, the team is working hard on getting the game through the last stretch of development as the release is looming on the horizon (more news on that soonish!). 

Anyway, for now, it’s time to unholster your gun and start blasting your way through the murky depths of Purgatory. 

(We recommend people to play with a gamepad for this Beta-session).

But before you do that - here’s what’s changed! 

Firstly, to everyone that played the game. THANKS. Your feedback has helped us direct the development of the game. We think the game has had some significant changes since the first beta, and there is still loads more. Here are but a few…

[b]Changes/Additions[/b]
- We added a Tutorial level. Your feedback really helped us focus this on areas that were the hardest to grasp.
- Armory (with upgradeable start items). We added a new Armory (which will be upgradeable in the final game).
- Changed Health Mechanics. We made the health recovery system more versatile, with different 'charms' allowing you to recover health through different mechanics.
- Runes! The Runes that you collect off some special bosses now unlock new abilities (including Teleportation, which was previously on by default - :P ).

[b]Quality of life[/b]
Your feedback really helped point out
- Camera style, we re-jigged the camera view when in combat to prioritise simplicity and readability, so that aiming feels more reliable.
- More Animations, Sound Effects (so many), Visual Effects
- We totally re-designed the GUI, so that the pause menu is more helpful
- The player now drops items after picking up new ones
- Holstered weapons are now visible on the hero

[b]Balance[/b]
- Lots of balancing, whether it was enemy damage, dive timings and health recovery mechanics, enemy group compositions. We adjusted, tuned and re-jigged so that the game feels fairer.

[b]Bugs![/b]
- Thanks for helping spot bugs (so many bugs...), we're still clamping down on them, but your insight has really helped.
- We also fixed the one amazing bug that meant the hero tripped up on nothing after having a conversation with the trader. It was very, very strange.
